sentences.text: However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 157 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
This Court, following the Division Bench ruling in MFA No.102543/2022 dated 23.09.2024, holds that the limitation period under the Act is mandatory and non- extendable.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. V.R. Kalliyanikutty1, the appeal is dismissed as time- barred, without addressing the merits.

opennyai_summary.decision:
However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 157 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
This Court, following the Division Bench ruling in MFA No.102543/2022 dated 23.09.2024, holds that the limitation period under the Act is mandatory and non- extendable.
Parties shall bear their respective costs.
